initial_conditions: An unsigned aarch64-apple-darwin package from the preceding catalog has twelve unresolved Cargo notices. Cargo has all locked archives in its cache.
actions: Build and package both executables offline before and after updating the catalog in the same worktree.
Compare emitted crate identities, license expressions, original notice files and executable hashes. Read back the staged bytes in the portable package and the standalone app.
expected_outcomes: Exactly seven newly resolved crates retain their pinned declarations and gain the 11,358-byte Apache-2.0 text linked from those declarations. Five MIT-only entries remain open. Each emitted notice verifies by size and SHA-256 in both copies.
